# PR tracker 

## Install

Add the plugin to the existing `plugins` array in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`:

```json
{ "plugins": ["@daoninc/opencode-pr-tracker@0.1.2"] }
```

Requires OpenCode V2 and a local authenticated GitHub CLI (`gh auth login`). Remove
the equivalent local entry when switching to npm. Do not enable this port alongside
the upstream tracker: their functionality overlaps, and published `0.1.0` still
shares its runtime ID. Starting with `0.1.1`, this port uses `daoninc.pr-tracker` and ships
Solid-compiled JavaScript. Do not use the raw-TSX `0.1.0` build with OpenCode 2.3.1.
This package is TUI-only.

For local development, run `bun run build` in `AI/opencode` and use the absolute
path to `AI/opencode/plugins/pr-tracker` in `cli.json` instead of the npm entry.

## Attribution and features

This TUI-only port is based on `@kitlangton/opencode-pr-tracker` 0.1.1
([source](https://github.com/kitlangton/opencode-plugins/tree/dd0de5a31b/packages/pr-tracker))
and the compatibility changes proposed in
[upstream PR #5](https://github.com/kitlangton/opencode-plugins/pull/5).
The upstream code is MIT-licensed; see `LICENSE`.

The **Pull requests** section starts collapsed, with the number of open PRs on
the right. Click the heading to expand or collapse it. The choice is kept for the
life of the TUI. Each row starts with the status, PR number, and title on the
same line. Long titles wrap. The current branch's PR is highlighted. Click a row
to open that PR on GitHub.

In `0.1.2`, the sidebar shows open PRs (including drafts) in this order:

1. The PR associated with the active session's checked-out branch.
2. PRs created with `gh pr create` across all sessions on the connected OpenCode
   server, including archived sessions, child sessions, and other projects.
3. Your open PRs in the active repository (`gh pr list --author @me --state open`, up to 100).

The tracker reads past sessions in the background and picks up new PRs as they
are created. Entries are deduplicated by URL. The tracker checks for updates every
45 seconds, and removes closed or merged PRs once it sees the new state. Lookups
by PR URL work even if the original worktree is gone. Branch and authored PR
lookups use the active session's local checkout. Failed authored-list lookups
retain the last successful list; switching directories clears it and ignores
late results from other directories. `git` and an authenticated `gh` CLI are required.

This package is maintained separately from upstream. Its version numbers are
independent. The upstream MIT license and copyright notice are included unchanged
in every package. Do not configure this plugin in the server's `opencode.json`.

The PR tracker icons:

| Icon | Meaning | Color |
|---|---|---|
| `◇` | Draft PR | Blue |
| `×` | CI checks failed/cancelled/timed out | Red |
| `◌` | CI checks pending or running | Yellow |
| `●` | Open with checks passed, or no checks | Green |

Draft status takes priority over the other indicators.
